newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Influence Inc plans $32.5 mln IPO in U.S..
newsitem.headline: Israel's Influence Inc plans $32.5 mln IPO in U.S..

text.p: Israel's Influence Inc, a maker of medical equipment, will raise up to $32.5 million in the United States in an initial public offering of 2.5 million shares, the company's underwriter said in a statement on Sunday.
Shares, equal to about 24.5 percent of equity, will be priced at $11 to $13 each, Montgomery Securities said. It said it had filed a draft prospectus to the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

Influence, founded in 1994, develops and markets products for diagnosis and treatment of urinary incontinence. The company already has U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approval for two of its products, Montgomery said.
Influence has a research and development centre in Ramat Gan and offices in San Francisco.
UBS and Robertson Stevens will act as sub-underwriters.
